name: kioku-skills
description: Skills and hooks for Kioku, a local MCP memory server for coding agents.

plugins.name: kioku-memory
plugins.description: Skills that keep a project's Kioku memory useful: checkpoint a session, orient a decision, refresh stale notes, sync a project's history, audit what is stored, and consolidate notes.

plugins.name: kioku-hooks
plugins.description: Brings Kioku memory into Claude Code sessions: notes at session start, for each prompt and for each file opened; a nudge to save after a commit or every few prompts; and a background review of the transcript at compaction and session end. Claude Code only.
